title: Multisite Autism Spectrum Disorder Classification Using Convolutional Neural Network Classifier and Individual Morphological Brain Networks.
summary: The paper reports cross-site classification performance on its multisite imaging dataset. The classification result does not establish a clinical diagnostic tool or generalization beyond the studied sites and labels.
ai_technology: A convolutional neural network classified autism-spectrum disorder using individual morphological brain networks derived from multisite MRI data.
